title: Grateful Dead Live at Olympia Theater on 1972-05-03
source: SBD -> 16 Track Master Reels (purportedly Healy's rough mix)-> DAT

ai_review.summary: High‑energy performance with solid soundboard capture, though a few Europe ’72 cuts run flat and contain studio overdubs.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the playing and overall vibe of this show, calling it near‑perfect, while also noting that three tracks from the Europe ’72 segment are pitched slightly low and feature studio vocal overdubs. The recording sounds clean for a soundboard source, but those pitch anomalies and splice concerns prevent it from being flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance praised by both reviewers (70% weight) offset by technical issues on specific tracks (30% weight), yielding an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard mix, but three Europe ’72 cuts are flat by ~½ semitone and contain studio vocal overdubs; possible splicing in the master.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing were provided.
